messages:
alice: Draft changelog + release notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/changelog-2201. Need a quick pass on Python snippets, migration guidance for quantized models, and Known Issues.

rob: I'll handle the Python SDK snippets and the migration blurb for quantized checkpoints. Noting two behavior changes: (1) quantize flag default is now 8-bit, (2) embedding normalization changed slightly.

maya: Running link/anchor checks now. Will flag any redirects and invalid anchors.

docs-bot: Linkcheck results for branch release/2201: 1 broken anchor -> /changelog/v1/quantize-migration. See CI job #438.

rob: I'll add a small migration paragraph and a one-line Python example. New snippet:
```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
emb = client.embeddings.create(type='text-similarity', input='...')
```
Also added: "If you previously relied on full-precision models, add `--quantize=32` to preserve behavior."

tanya: UX note: add Known Issue about canary routing cache — some clients may briefly receive the previous model variant during rollout (~20-40s) while routing tables propagate. Suggest adding rollback steps.

alice: Good catch — add rollback steps (pin model by version + clear route cache). Keep the Known Issue concise.

ops-bot: Deploy windows: staging 14:00 UTC, production 20:00 UTC.

maya: Re-ran checks after rob's edits: anchor fixed, image assets show a 301 -> imagecdn; added a short line in relnotes: "image assets now served via imagecdn (301)" and filed issue #918 for ops redirect docs.

alice: Thanks everyone. Merging in 10 unless anyone objects. Follow-ups: PR 1302 (snippets + migration), issue #918 (imagecdn redirect), and issue #919 (canary routing note).

rob: LGTM, will add a short entry to the Python SDK release notes calling out the quantize default change.

tanya: LGTM :thumbsup:

alice: Merged. Will ping #product once prod is live and attach the final changelog copy.
